cohort: Patients using IVF and/or ICSI, with autologous or donor oocytes, undergoing fresh or cryopreserved transfer, who delivered a live-born fetus at ≥24 weeks of gestation at a single academic medical center, from 2005 to 2011 (n = 1,571)
finding: Cryopreserved embryo transfer (CET) was found to be a strong independent risk factor for placenta accreta among patients using IVF and/or ICSI.
